description: Used to define the headers for a `v-data-table`.

props.color: Applies a color to checkboxes, page size dropdown and sort badges in the table header.
props.sortIcon: Icon used for unsorted columns. By default it uses either **sortAscIcon** or **sortDescIcon** depending on **initialSortOrder**, but can be customized to show a neutral icon instead.
props.sortAscIcon: Icon used for ascending sort button.
props.sortDescIcon: Icon used for descending sort button.
props.headerProps: Additional props to be be passed to the default header
props.disableSort: Disables sorting from the column headers.
props.fixedHeader: Sticks the header to the top of the table.
props.multiSort: Shows sort priority badges and allows multiple selection on mobile.
props.selectAllLabel: Accessible label for the select-all checkbox. Accepts locale keys.
props.initialSortOrder: Picks the sort icon shown on unsorted columns.

slots.[`column.${string}`]: Slot for custom rendering of a column.
slots.[`header.${string}`]: Slot for custom rendering of a header cell.
slots.header.data-table-expand: Slot for the expand button in the header.
slots.header.data-table-select: Slot for the select-all checkbox in the header.
slots.headers: Slot to replace the default rendering of the `<thead>` element.
slots.mobile.header: Replaces the content of the header shown in mobile mode (sort select and select-all checkbox). Receives the same props as the `headers` slot.
